CoordinationIterationTrace.description:
Lightweight immutable replay evidence for one communication tick.

Epoch identifies the barrier being collected. References are AFTER this
tick's projection (unchanged if global_updated is false). Time is a separate
planning axis in hours, never a conversion of communication_tick.
CoordinationIterationTrace.title: CoordinationIterationTrace

CoordinationNetworkCalibration.description:
Immutable chronological reference data, not a network feasibility certificate.

Losses are nonnegative series MW/Mvar. Shunts are separate signed injections
at the reference voltages. All trajectories have the same interval axis.
See docs/modeling/Coordination_Network_Calibration.md.
CoordinationNetworkCalibration.title: CoordinationNetworkCalibration

CoordinationRecoveryPolicy.description: Bounded regional calibration feedback, not a recursive feasibility proof.
CoordinationRecoveryPolicy.title: CoordinationRecoveryPolicy

CoordinationSnapshot.description:
One completed barrier update; row order is the order of `regions`.

The local plans consumed epoch k, and the new references/duals are for k+1.
`converged` certifies the aggregate convex problem only, never execution.
CoordinationSnapshot.title: CoordinationSnapshot

DeviceCheckpoint.description: State before the next SIL minute; contains no future plant observations.
DeviceCheckpoint.title: DeviceCheckpoint

DispatchCapabilities.description:
One dispatch request's device participation, not physical nameplate data.

Disabled storage provides neither active nor reactive support, matching
existing central solvers. Its initial energy is held fixed.

One bus's signed nominal and voltage-dependent reference injection, Mvar.

Capacitive injection is positive; inductive injection is negative. Only
buses with nonzero resolved nominal injection belong in this value.

JointNetworkEvidence.description: A bounded solve record; failure never proves original AC infeasibility.
JointNetworkEvidence.title: JointNetworkEvidence

At a minute boundary; missing model_version preserves historical meaning.

V2 availability is a nonnegative increment from storage_power_mw to an
H-hour constant target, not a dynamic or network deliverability certificate.

NetworkCandidateSelection.title: NetworkCandidateSelection

ReactivePlanningPolicy.description:
Study Q envelope; v1 is retained for historical endpoint-only replay.

v2 certifies a constant-command transition on the declared execution grid,
at fixed P and capability. It does not certify feedback tracking or AC paths.

RegionalCoordinationTrace.description:
Coordinator's latest accepted proposal, never a device measurement.

Positive P/Q mean PCC import. Missing proposals remain None. Fresh means
eligible for this barrier epoch, including an unexpired buffered response.
Outage and local fallback are independent observations, not inferred from P.
RegionalCoordinationTrace.title: RegionalCoordinationTrace

RegionalNetworkCandidate.description:
One same-window physical witness projected onto the PCC, MW/Mvar.

Certification and window ownership belong to the calling workflow. This
value never certifies interpolation, extrapolation or time-slice mixing.
The loss calibration belongs to THIS witness, not the most recent round.
RegionalNetworkCandidate.title: RegionalNetworkCandidate

RegionalPlanSnapshot.description: Owned immutable values of the local solve used in an ADMM update.
RegionalPlanSnapshot.title: RegionalPlanSnapshot

RenewableAccounting.description:
Chronological interval MW. Availability is AFTER the rated-MW bound.

Raw predictions remain diagnostics. Excess above rated availability is not
controllable curtailment. Tuples own their values and cannot mutate callers.
RenewableAccounting.title: RenewableAccounting
